purpose: Support-only deterministic replay check on an already-exposed task. It tests the content-addressed policy-response cache and carries zero scientific evidence for evaluation aliasing.
cache_key_scope: full OpenAI-compatible chat request, including model, system message, user message, temperature, max tokens, and request seed
interpretation: The first trajectory populates one response per unique visited policy prompt. Subsequent identical prompts reuse the first response. A changed observation, action history, admissible-command list, memory condition, or other request field changes the request hash and therefore cannot hit the same cache entry.
